purpose: Teach: 瓩/屬/璽/錣/註/楼/个/北村

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、旧単位瓩、つまりキログラム表記の文献を読め
lines.en: Ren, read the literature on old kilogram units—the pre-war documentation using that notation.
lines.style: Steady, measured instruction. Direct eye contact. A prompt, not a question. Weight behind each phrase. Brief pause before the clarification, letting it land as important context.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。旧字「屬」、つまり属の使われ方の論文を読みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll read the papers on how the old character for 'belong' was used in that period.
lines.style: Attentive nod in the voice. Quick uptake, no hesitation. Respectful but not obsequious. A light click of commitment at the end—he's taking mental notes.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、皇室の璽、つまり国璽の歴史を学べ
lines.en: Ren, study the history of the Imperial seal—the State seal and its significance.
lines.style: Same measured authority. Slightly slower than the first task. Each task carries equal weight. No inflection of preference, only clarity of expectation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。武家の錣、つまり兜部位の論文を読みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll read the papers on helmet components used by samurai clans—specifically the parts.
lines.style: Same quick, clean acceptance. No confusion despite the shift in topic. Steady, organized. He's building a list in his head and he knows it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文の註、つまり脚注を充実させろ
lines.en: Ren, strengthen the footnotes in your paper. Make them substantive.
lines.style: Shift to a more direct correction. Still measured but with a faint edge—this is about his own work, not just reading. Brief. Expects compliance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。歴史的な楼閣、つまり古楼建築の論文を読みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll enhance the citations and references to support the historical arguments.
lines.style: Careful, deliberate repeat-back. He's understood the critique and is already reframing it as an action. Polite formality at the edges but genuine commitment underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、古文献の个、つまり個の数え方を研究しろ
lines.en: Ren, research the classical counting systems—how the counter for 'individual' was used in old texts.
lines.style: Back to assignment mode. Slightly more specific and technical than the seal task. Pause before the clarification. This is detail-work, and he's being told it matters.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。指導教授の北村先生にご助言を仰ぎます
lines.en: Yes. I'll speak with Professor Kitamura, my advisor, and ask for his guidance on this.
lines.style: Respectful close. Acknowledges he needs outside input—not weakness, but wisdom. Soft landing on the final phrase. The conversation is complete; he's moving to the next step.
